title: Your AI Agent Has Keys. Who Gave It Permission?
description:
The phone is not the product. The permission layer is. Today in The AI Edge, Alex, Jamie, and Rufus teach permission layer: who can approve, access, trigger, delete, escalate, or spend when an AI agent starts acting.

What we covered:
• AI in Life Science Market worth $69.34 billion by 2031
• Pope to Launch Encyclical on AI Alongside Anthropic Co-Founder
• Anthropic's Claude Code adds a built-in evaluator to catch agents that quit too soon
• Lyrie: Open-source autonomous pentesting agent
• Former OpenAI Employee’s Hedge Fund Unveils Massive Nvidia and AI Chip Options Positions

Tomorrow tension: Tomorrow’s question: if your agent can act for you, who decided where its authority stops?

A dynamic AI lesson through the day’s biggest stories: permission layer, explained with banter, receipts, Signal or Static, and The Ledger Readout.
